keyFindings: The official bundled binary is `obsidian` and requires the desktop app.
The official CLI covers CRUD, search, backlinks, daily notes, tags, properties/frontmatter, and templates.
Local REST API is an in-app community plugin using bearer-token authentication.
Local REST API now bundles a Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint at `/mcp/`.
The maintained headless content CLI is `notesmd-cli`, not the legacy `obsidian-cli` identity.
The official npm `obsidian-headless` binary `ob` handles Sync and Publish rather than note management.
npm and binary `obsidian-mcp-server` wrap Local REST API and therefore remain app-coupled.
npm and binary `obsidian-mcp` access vault files directly and work without Obsidian or a token.
The built-in Local REST API MCP endpoint is the default MCP adoption candidate.
Dedicated backlink and template tools remain gaps in the strongest MCP candidates.
The final CLI decision is adopt official `obsidian`, with `notesmd-cli` only for an explicit headless profile.
The final MCP decision is adopt Local REST API built-in MCP through `mcp-remote`, with filesystem `obsidian-mcp` only for an explicit headless profile.
The Code Mode secret key is `obsidian_OBSIDIAN_AUTH_HEADER`, mapped from manual-local `OBSIDIAN_AUTH_HEADER`.
The justified build scope is routing, safety, install/doctor, fixtures, and optional compatibility shims.
